name: arcs-conformance
alternateName: Conformance suite for the Agent Run Conformance Specification (ARCS-1)
description: An open conformance test suite for the Agent Run Conformance Specification (ARCS-1), the aerospace profile of TRACE (Trust, Runtime Attestation and Compliance Evidence), whose one canonical copy it carries. ARCS-1 defines how a conformance record is serialised, identified, signed with Ed25519 (one instance of the Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm), verified and withdrawn. It checks the software that verifies such records, in any language, through a protocol of one JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) request on standard input and one JSON answer on standard output. Every case cites the clause of ARCS-1 it tests, and every conformance criterion is reported on its own. It needs nothing but the Python standard library and no network connection. A pass is evidence about the cases run, not a certification. Published by Ashforde OÜ, a private limited company (osaühing) registered in Estonia.
